intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Apparently I have the courage of a thousand soldiers.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She is holding a letter of commendation. Its wax seal is the size of a saucer.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “A logistical nightmare. Where would they all sleep?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Also the heart of a lion and the eyes of a hawk. I am becoming a menagerie.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “There were seven of us. The lion got the credit.”

options.labelText: “Write back. Name the other six. No lions.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She is already writing. The reply runs to two pages: six names, and a sentence about each.

options.labelText: “Frame it. Seriously. People should see this.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Framed. Above the six people it forgot.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She folds the letter around its enormous seal and puts it away.
